features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.description:
The Old Wood adds spells to your warlock spell list:

| Spell Level | Spells |
|---|---|
| 1st | animal friendship, faerie fire |
| 2nd | animal messenger, spike growth |
| 3rd | conjure animals, protection from energy |
| 4th | conjure woodland beings, giant insect |
| 5th | greater restoration, tree stride |

features.name: Forest's Defender
features.description: At 1st level, your patron gifts you proficiency with shields and the *shillelagh* cantrip (counts as a warlock cantrip, doesn't count against cantrips known).

features.name: Sap Magic
features.description: At 1st level, when a creature casts a spell of a level you can cast or lower within 30 ft of you, use your reaction to synthesize the magic. The spell resolves normally, but you have a 25% chance of regaining HP equal to your warlock level + CHA modifier (min 1).

payload.name: Sap Magic
payload.description: When a creature within 30 ft casts a spell of a level you can cast: 25% chance to regain HP equal to warlock level + CHA mod.

features.name: The Old Wood and Your Pact Boons
features.description:
At 3rd level, your pact boon is altered:

**Pact of the Chain.** Familiar can be an awakened shrub or child of the briar.
**Pact of the Blade.** When you cast *shillelagh*, your Pact Blade is affected regardless of its form.
**Pact of the Tome.** Your tome's cover is hardened bark; pages are seasonal leaves. To add a new spell, plant the tome for 1 hour; it emerges with the spell inscribed.

features.name: Predatory Grace
features.description: Starting at 6th level, cast *pass without trace* without expending a spell slot. 1/short or long rest. Natural forest difficult terrain (roots, underbrush) costs you no extra movement. You can pass through nonmagical plants without being slowed or taking damage from thorns.

features.name: Nature's Endurance
features.description: At 10th level, you gain resistance to damage from spells of a level you can cast or lower.

features.name: Avatar of the Wood
features.description:
Starting at 14th level, as a bonus action, transform for 1 minute:

* AC = 16 + DEX modifier.
* Tremorsense 30 ft; attacks reach +5 ft.
* Claw attacks (proficient, magical, CHA to attack/damage, 1d6 slashing; benefits from Pact of the Blade invocations).
* Sap Magic upgrades to Arcasynthesis: when a 5th level or lower spell is cast within 60 ft, use reaction to synthesize — 50% chance to regain 1d10 HP per spell level.

1/short or long rest.

payload.name: Avatar of the Wood
payload.description: Transform for 1 min: AC 16+DEX, tremorsense 30 ft, reach +5 ft, claw attacks, Arcasynthesis (50% regain 1d10 HP/spell level on nearby casts).
